seq.description: Counts up from 1 for each add-in load; a gap means events were missed.

kind.description: The event kind, for example document.saved.

time.description: When it was raised, UTC, ISO 8601.

events.description: The events after after_seq, oldest first.

missed.description: True when events after after_seq were already dropped from the add-in's buffer.

last_seq.description: The sequence number of the last event raised.
